result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "leg_id", "consignment_id", "service_class_id", "carrier_id", "departed_on", "weight_grams", "charge_cents", "transit_minutes", "distance_km", "package_count", "planned_transit_minutes", "status" FROM "shipment_legs"), __grouped AS (SELECT t5."zone" AS "destination_zone", (COALESCE(SUM(t0."weight_grams"), 0) / :scale_transported_weight) AS "transported_weight" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "consignments" t1 ON t0."consignment_id" COLLATE BINARY = t1."consignment_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "depots" t4 ON t1."destination_depot_id" COLLATE BINARY = t4."depot_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "zones" t5 ON t4."zone_id" COLLATE BINARY = t5."zone_id" COLLATE BINARY WHERE t0."charge_cents" > :filter_0 GROUP BY t5."zone") SELECT "destination_zone", "transported_weight" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "transported_weight" DESC, "destination_zone" ASC LIMIT :result_limit

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "leg_id", "consignment_id", "service_class_id", "carrier_id", "departed_on", "weight_grams", "charge_cents", "transit_minutes", "distance_km", "package_count", "planned_transit_minutes", "status" FROM "shipment_legs" UNION ALL SELECT "leg_id", "consignment_id", "service_class_id", "carrier_id", "departed_on", "weight_grams", "charge_cents", "transit_minutes", "distance_km", "package_count", "planned_transit_minutes", "status" FROM "archive_shipment_legs"), __grouped AS (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t0."consignment_id"), 0) AS "distinct_consignments", COALESCE(COUNT(1), 0) AS "leg_count" FROM __facts t0) SELECT "distinct_consignments", "leg_count" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "distinct_consignments" DESC LIMIT :result_limit

metrics.label: Transported weight
metrics.description: Kilograms transported across selected shipment legs, summing recorded leg weights; a consignment carried on several legs contributes on each leg. Null weights do not contribute.

metrics.label: Handling charges
metrics.description: Shipment-leg handling charges in USD, summing recorded leg charges and dividing cents by 100. Excludes consignment charges, service tariffs, carrier fees and exception fees. Null charges do not contribute.

metrics.label: Average transit minutes
metrics.description: Arithmetic mean of recorded transit minutes per selected shipment leg. Null transit durations are excluded from numerator and denominator. This is not end-to-end consignment transit time.

metrics.label: Distinct consignments
metrics.description: Number of distinct non-null consignment references represented by selected shipment legs, including references missing from the consignment table. Count separately within each group; grouped counts are not additive.

metrics.label: Leg count
metrics.description: Number of shipment-leg fact rows in the selected population, regardless of missing dimensions or null measurements.

populations.label: Current and archived records
populations.description: Combine aligned current and archive fact rows. UNION ALL keeps every row; UNION removes exact duplicate fact rows.
